name: Ability Damage
description: Immune to temporary ability score damage.

name: Ability Drain
description: Immune to permanent ability score drain.

name: Acid
description: Immune to acid damage and caustic effects.

name: Bleed
description: Immune to continuous bleed damage.

name: Blindness
description: Immune to being blinded.

name: Charm
description: Immune to charm spells (charm person, charm monster).

name: Cold
description: Immune to cold damage and freezing effects.

name: Compulsion
description: Immune to compulsion spells (dominate person, command, suggestion).

name: Confusion
description: Immune to confusion spells, madness, and insanity effects.

name: Construct Traits
description: Immune to mind-affecting, bleed, disease, death, paralysis, poison, sleep, stun, nonlethal, ability damage, ability drain, Fortitude saves not affecting objects.

name: Critical Hits
description: Immune to extra damage and special effects from critical hits.

name: Daze
description: Immune to daze effects and spells that cause dazed condition.

name: Deafness
description: Immune to being deafened.

name: Death Effects
description: Immune to spells and effects that cause instantaneous death (finger of death, slay living).

name: Disease
description: Immune to all natural and supernatural diseases.

name: Electricity
description: Immune to electricity damage and lightning effects.

name: Energy Drain
description: Immune to negative levels and energy drain.

name: Exhaustion
description: Immune to the exhausted condition.

name: Fatigue
description: Immune to the fatigued condition.

name: Fear
description: Immune to all fear effects, shaken, frightened, and panicked conditions.

name: Fire
description: Immune to fire damage and fire effects.

name: Flanking
description: Cannot be flanked; attackers gain no flank bonus or sneak attack.

name: Force
description: Immune to force damage and effects created by force spells (such as Magic Missile).

name: Gaze Attacks
description: Immune to all supernatural and extraordinary gaze attacks.

name: Magic (Golem Immunity)
description: Immune to any spell or spell-like ability that allows spell resistance.

name: Mind-Affecting Effects
description: Immune to all charms, compulsions, morale effects, patterns, and phantasms.

name: Negative Energy
description: Immune to damage and penalties caused by negative energy effects.

name: Nonlethal Damage
description: Immune to all nonlethal damage.

name: Ooze Traits
description: Immune to mind-affecting, poison, sleep, paralysis, polymorph, stunning, critical hits, and flanking.

name: Paralysis
description: Immune to paralysis effects and hold spells.

name: Petrification
description: Immune to flesh to stone and other petrification effects.

name: Plant Traits
description: Immune to mind-affecting, paralysis, poison, polymorph, sleep, and stunning.

name: Poison
description: Immune to all forms of poison (contact, ingested, inhaled, and injury).

name: Polymorph
description: Immune to polymorph and shape-changing effects unless willing.

name: Positive Energy
description: Immune to damage and effects caused by positive energy effects.

name: Precision Damage
description: Immune to sneak attack damage and precision-based damage.

name: Sleep
description: Immune to magical and nonmagical sleep effects.

name: Sonic
description: Immune to sonic damage and deafening effects.

name: Stun
description: Immune to stunning effects, spells, and abilities (such as Stunning Fist).

name: Stunning
description: Immune to the stunned condition.

name: Swarm Traits
description: Immune to critical hits, flanking, tripping, grappling, bull rush, and weapon damage (if Fine/Diminutive).

name: Undead Traits
description: Immune to mind-affecting, bleed, death, disease, paralysis, poison, sleep, stun, nonlethal, ability drain, energy drain.

name: Visual Effects
description: Immune to patterns, blinding effects, and visual illusions.
